override._why: From about 43 s, A on the dossier name entry opens 'overwrite the saved game?' (NO default) and Start dismisses it, so the run loops. YES only goes back to the Dossier screen, where Start/A re-enter SELECT DOSSIER, and on the main menu Start/A just open and close the Start menu. Right+A picks YES, down down A picks the Dossier ACCEPT, then A's go Campaign > New Campaign > Proceed > Briefing Proceed > Auto Assign > GO into the mission.
